code: problems <- houdini_validate(template, config, rtf_dir, quiet = TRUE) nrow(problems) #> [1] 0 broken <- config broken$Bookmark[2] <- "Table_Nosie"   # a typo houdini_validate(template, broken, rtf_dir, quiet = TRUE)[, c("row", "severity", "message")] #>   row severity                                                message #> 1   2    error Bookmark 'Table_Nosie' not found in the Word document. problems <- houdini_validate(template, config, rtf_dir) if (any(problems$severity == "error")) stop("config is not ready")

Houdini:::err_hint(bad[["1"]]$err) #> [1] "Check that the bookmark name in the config table matches exactly (case-sensitive) the bookmark in the Word file."

title: Automatic Table & Figure Insertion into Data Containing Documents
text: Programmatically insert data tables figures report Word documents. Houdini R package injecting RTF tables figures Word (.docx) template named bookmarks. parses RTF output (kind produced SAS), lets interactively filter trim table, writes fully-formatted Word document native OOXML tables.

title: Automatic Table & Figure Insertion into Data Containing Documents
text: Given: Word template (.docx) containing named bookmarks content go Excel Document (.xlsx) config data frame contains bookmark table mappings filtering instructions folder RTF files, one per table figure, Houdini maps bookmark RTF file generate, injects corresponding table (real Word table) figure (png) bookmarked paragraph. Tables figures scaled document’s text width automatically. Along way can, per table: Filter pages parameter (e.g. Parameter: Cholesterol). Filter data rows timepoint label (e.g. Week 1, Week 4). Filter data indent level (e.g. prefered term) Interactively exclude columns rows clicking preview specifying config document.

title: Automatic Table & Figure Insertion into Data Containing Documents
text: Houdini contains C fast-path, installation needs working toolchain (Rtools Windows, standard build tools macOS/Linux). Note: C available, alternative R functions exist take place.

title: Automatic Table & Figure Insertion into Data Containing Documents
text: opens Shiny app browser. : Word Document - upload .docx template. Houdini lists bookmarks finds. RTF Source - choose folder containing RTF files (inside RStudio native folder picker offered; elsewhere paste folder path). Table Configuration - map bookmark RTF table. Click row preview configure filters/exclusions. Generate - download finished Word document. generation log available alongside .

title: Automatic Table & Figure Insertion into Data Containing Documents
text: run Houdini process current working directory output modified word document log file detailing successes, warning errors occur insertion filtering.

title: Automatic Table & Figure Insertion into Data Containing Documents

title: Automatic Table & Figure Insertion into Data Containing Documents
text: pipeline deliberately dependency-light - external RTF Word libraries: Parse RTF structured page/row/cell representation (R/parsing.R, C fast-path src/ pure-R fallback). Filter combine pages parameter/timeline apply exclusions. Render minimal OOXML (R/xml.R) HTML preview (R/html.R). Inject OOXML unzipped .docx, rezip (R/docx.R).
